Confirmed: resume an interrupted mock; leave blanks; change answers before finishing.
Some exam-specific rules may restrict returning; verify each source first.
Time expiry: finish automatically with recorded answers.
Timer pauses when leaving and resumes with remaining time.
Open: scoring, persistence and actual exam rules.
QConcursos “Errei” behavior after a later correct answer remains unverified.
Reference: https://suporte.qconcursos.com/pt-BR/articles/12118570-como-usar-os-filtros-de-questoes
These paths have not yet been tested with a user.
